topics.title: The Cascade, Specificity & Box Model
topics.objective: Understand rule priority, specificity calculations, margins, borders, padding, and content dimensions.
topics.exercise: Recreate a card component demonstrating precise padding, border, and margin spacing.

topics.title: Flexbox One-Dimensional Layouts
topics.objective: Align and distribute items along main and cross axes using display: flex, justify-content, and align-items.
topics.example: .container { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
topics.exercise: Build a responsive navigation header and sticky footer using flexbox layout directives.

topics.title: CSS Grid Two-Dimensional Grid Systems
topics.objective: Construct complex multi-track layouts using grid-template-columns, fr units, and grid-template-areas.
topics.example: .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
topics.exercise: Implement a dynamic dashboard grid layout with sidebar, header, and multi-column widgets.

topics.title: Responsive Design & Mobile-First Media Queries
topics.objective: Adapt visual hierarchies across device widths using min-width media queries and fluid clamp() typography.
topics.exercise: Design a mobile-first product pricing table that smoothly reflows from 1 column to 3 columns.

topics.title: CSS Custom Properties (Variables) & Animations
topics.objective: Implement reusable design token variables, transitions, and keyframe animations.
topics.exercise: Construct a complete light/dark theme switcher using CSS custom properties and smooth transitions.
